title: Powerball Number Watch — Number 11 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws
headline: Number 11 Has Gone Quiet for 50+ Draws

prose.intro: The Powerball board has a new record holder for silence. Number 11 has gone 50+ straight drawings without an appearance.
prose.fact: For scale: the longest completed drought inside the same window was 42 draws. At 50+, number 11 has now pushed past everything we had measured.
prose.context: Worth saying plainly: none of this makes anything "due". Every drawing starts from scratch, and no gap or pattern carries over. This entry documents an extreme in the dataset — that's all it is.
